LightningComponentBundle.description: Date or zoned date/time picker with explicit clock-change choices.

property.name: allowOffsetOverride
property.label: Allow supplied-offset overrides
property.description: Allow entering an explicit UTC offset independently of the selected timezone's rules.

property.name: initialChronoValue
property.label: Initial ISO date or datetime
property.description: A Chrono ISO date, local datetime, instant or zoned datetime. Use a Text resource or another Chrono action output.

property.name: offsetOverride
property.label: Supplied UTC offset
property.description: Optional +01:00 or -05:00 override. Used with the entered wall time to derive the instant. Returned when changed; empty restores automatic zone rules.

property.name: lockOperatingHoursSelection
property.label: Lock operating-hours selection
property.description: For collection or search sources, lock the supplied selected ID. Single-record and dynamic schedules are always fixed.

property.name: mode
property.label: Input mode
property.description: Use date for a calendar date, or datetime for a date and time in a time zone.

property.name: dateStyle
property.label: Date display style
property.description: Locale-aware short (numeric), medium (abbreviated month), or long (full month) display.

property.name: timeZoneSelectionMode
property.label: Timezone selection scope
property.description: all preserves unrestricted selection; list restricts selection to supplied IDs. An empty list never enables all timezones.

property.name: timeZoneIds
property.label: Allowed timezones from Flow
property.description: Text collection of timezone IDs. Combined with the fixed allowed timezones.

property.name: timeZoneIdsText
property.label: Fixed allowed timezones
property.description: Timezone IDs maintained by the inline list editor.

property.name: allowTimeZoneSelection
property.label: Allow the user to change time zone

property.name: timeZoneId
property.label: Time-zone ID
property.description: For example Europe/London. Defaults to the running user's zone. Returned when the user changes it. Ignored in date mode.

property.name: dateValue
property.label: Date value
property.description: Calendar date in date mode; selected local date in datetime mode. No timezone conversion in date mode.

property.name: dateTimeValue
property.label: Datetime value
property.description: Exact UTC instant in datetime mode. An existing value is displayed in the configured zone. Cleared while an edited time is unresolved.

property.name: operatingHoursIdsText
property.label: Fixed allowed OperatingHours IDs
property.description: Comma-separated IDs, combined with any supplied ID collection.
